notes.title: Mio featuring in new game - Cosplay Crisis - Succubus Invaion
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071210/Cosplay_Crisis__Succubus_Invasion]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071210/Cosplay_Crisis__Succubus_Invasion[/url]

Cosplay Crisis launches any day now. With Mio among the main cast. 
(or someone cosplaying her at least, she looks a little more tan than she did in Mommy Milkers Miko)

Cosplay Crisis is a roguelite bullet heaven about a Succubus that wants to win a cosplay contest at a convention, who charms the male attendees to try and destroy her competition. The girls have to take up arms to defend their outfits or be sent home blushing. It features 4 levels, lots of weapons, and a unique talisman weapon for Mio that makes pretty patterns.

The game also features Phantom Thief Sylphy!
[url= https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728550/Phantom_Thief_Sylphy]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728550/Phantom_Thief_Sylphy[/url]

The earliest Cosplay Crisis can launch is August 1st.

notes.title: Big update, new content
notes.content:
New Content
in order to fix the limited amount of stuff to do in the first half of the game, I added a fighting arena in the slums. 3 new fights, 2 new live2d sex animations. now the money goal can be reached cleared only doing each thing once.

I also added an evasion QTE to the game to make combat more interesting, though it also gets used in other places. It pretty much rippled into everything, strong attacks and grabs can be dodged. and since fights are longer now, guards can call for help.
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/555213412209262593/1095728446103109693/image.png[/img]
Fans of Kate's Test might recognise it. Though I definitely built it more efficiently this time.

I've also fixed a bunch of bugs, typos, edited the town map since some people didnt realise you could jump over the water and missed out on the milking job.

Since the arena can remove your clothing, I've also made it so you warp back to the inn when nude.


also, i finally got the gamepad triggers working for the grapple, so I can finally mark full controller support down.

The assassination minigame now actually has lasting consequences, thanks to the qte the insertion can be dodged indefinitely up until she's maxed out lust 3 times (and she can use spirit waters to reduce the count between each assasination target)


This is the first time I've added content post launch. I hope everyone likes it.



Also, apologies, the new Live2d models means the saves you have will be corrupted... Yeah, that's so annoying during playtesting too...
